title: 5-Year Treasury Note auction — the January block's middle leg, selling on FOMC day one
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), RE-FETCHED direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 by this event's own initial research (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) and its text layer decompressed stream-by-stream — NOT carried from the proposing sweep's transcription. Row reads verbatim `5-Year NOTE Thursday, January 21, 2027 Tuesday, January 26, 2027 Monday, February 01, 2027` (announcement / auction / settlement) with NO trailing `R` against the PDF's own `R --denotes reopening` legend, so a new issue — consistent with all 374 nominal 5-Year auctions on the fiscaldata record since 1991, none of which is a reopening. 1:00pm ET is Treasury's standing coupon-auction convention and is NOT separately sourced. STAYS ESTIMATE on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. The confirming primary is the 2027-01-21 announcement itself, 134 days out. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-09), after reading the one prior proposal per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md: `proposals/treasury-5y-note-2027-01-26.from-treasury-coupon-announcement-2027-01-21.json` (2026-09-09). This file adopts its title, date, kind, impact and estimate status; the proposal stays where it is and is now shadowed. FOMC POSITION, INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED: federalreserve.gov's FOMC calendar page, fetched direct this session (HTTP 200), lists the 2027 meetings as `January 26-27`, so 2027-01-26 is the meeting's FIRST DAY — the 1:00pm ET bidding deadline lands with the committee in session and the statement 26 hours away. THE FINDING THAT EARNS THIS EVENT ITS LEDGER, and it is NOT the FOMC-day-one framing the proposal named: selling on the eve of a statement is a MEASURED NULL on this auction — across all 17 such 5-Year sales since 1998 the auction-day 5Y-minus-avg(3Y,7Y) move is -0.59bp against -0.42bp for the other 273 (Welch t = -0.41, permutation p = 0.72 on 20k draws), bid-to-cover 2.50 vs 2.47 (t = 0.39). What the FOMC actually does to this event is SCHEDULE DISPLACEMENT, and that is worth more than the null: the same schedule fetch puts the block at 2Y Mon 01-25, 5Y Tue 01-26, 2Y FRN Wed 01-27 (statement day), 7Y Thu 01-28 — so the 7-Year is pushed OFF the 5-Year's D+1. That matters because this calendar's most-cited rates result is confounded by exactly that adjacency: in the 2023+ regime 41 of 43 5-Year auctions (95%) have the block's own 7-Year auctioning the very next session, so the +0.56bp `give-back' the treasury-5y-note-2026-11-24 sibling used to refute the par-curve re-anchoring story is measured almost entirely on sessions carrying a different auction at one of the two tenors the measure subtracts. Measured in the pre-2023 sample where the confound is only 61%: D+1 runs -0.61bp (t = -4.69, n=151) when the 7Y is there against -0.24bp (t = -2.52, n=96) when it is not, Welch t = -2.26, permutation p = 0.039 — a ~0.37bp DOWNWARD bias, with the D+0 control showing no such split (-0.07 vs -0.45, t = +1.42, if anything the other way). The bias works AGAINST the sibling's conclusion, so that conclusion was understated, not overstated. 2027-01-26 is one of the few decontaminated observations available: only 9 of 290 auctions on the whole record and 2 of 43 in the current regime have the 7Y at D+2 rather than D+1. AND THE MEASUREMENT SURVIVES THE STATEMENT, which is what makes the experiment viable: on 2023+ FOMC statement days the outright 5Y sd is 9.13bp against 6.46 ordinary, but the neighbour-subtracted measure is QUIETER than an ordinary session (sd 0.77 vs 0.97) because a policy statement moves the belly close to parallel and the subtraction cancels it. THE DIRECT PRECEDENT is one year old and in-configuration: 2026-01-27 was also a January 5-Year selling on a statement eve with the 7Y at D+2, at $70B — b/c 2.34 (era p25), dealer takedown 10.85% (6th lowest of 28), D+0 -1.00, then +0.50/+0.50/+0.50. SIZE EXPECTATION $70B, unchanged for 28 consecutive auctions (2024-04-24 -> 2026-08-26, fiscaldata, zero deviations), but UNPUBLISHED FOR JANUARY 2027 and not asserted here: sb0590 (2026-08-05), read direct this session, publishes actuals for May-Jul 2026 and anticipated sizes for Aug-Oct 2026 only — one quarter forward — so the Jan-27 anticipated size is first published at the 2026-11-04 refunding and the binding number is the 2027-01-21 announcement. Read-it-do-not-trade-it: `symbols: []`, the date is `estimate`, and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed. Ledger: docs/research/events/treasury-5y-note-2027-01-26.md.
